description: This Java class 'SecuredShopPersistableCustomer' extends 'SecuredCustomer' and adds additional fields related to CAPTCHA validation ('recaptcha_challenge_field' and 'recaptcha_response_field') as well as a password check. It includes getter and setter methods with validation annotations to ensure CAPTCHA fields are not empty and meet size constraints.

classes.name: SecuredShopPersistableCustomer
classes.description: Represents a secure, persistable customer with CAPTCHA fields and password validation, extending the base 'SecuredCustomer' class.
